title: Unit 42 Consolidation: Post Office & Delivery Services
goal: I have mastered all core Hungarian postal pragmatics: queuing, registered mail, yellow cheques, and parcel lockers.
I can confidently send, pay, track, and collect letters and packages anywhere in Hungary.
